UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user account profile storing plan entitlements and AI credit usage.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication user UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the Studio header (nullable).

isPro.description: Whether the user has an active Pro subscription (server-managed after creation).

aiCreditsUsed.description: Number of AI copy generation credits consumed.

aiCreditsLimit.description: Maximum free-tier AI copy credits allowed (server-managed after creation).

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp recorded when the profile was created.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only private user profiles containing PII, subscription plan, and AI credit usage.
